documented_probe: Covering task for C-92072676 (connect to a postgres service using compose-provided credentials) at medium difficulty; verifier fully checks the capability on hidden stack/database scenarios.
notes: Single-stage: parse a compose-style stack file (mapping or list-style environment, decoy services), derive host port from the published mapping (non-default port), connect with the file-provided credentials (scram enforced on TCP so wrong passwords fail), and produce an exact low-stock report. Hidden scenarios vary service name, credentials, database, data, and include a zero-low-stock edge. Nonzero rubric for reasoning_depth (compose parsing + port mapping direction), adversarial_inputs/hidden_case_generalization (three hidden stacks), quantitative_correctness (exact rows, units, rounded value).
